description: Gives an indicative range for the fair market value per share of a US private company's common stock, as a planning estimate before a formal 409A valuation (for example, to anticipate an option strike price). Uses an option pricing model backsolve when there is a priced round in the last 12 months; otherwise a rolled-forward round, a sector revenue multiple, or an asset-based approach, depending on the inputs. Applies Finnerty and Chaffe marketability discounts. Inputs are numbers from the cap table and financials; no company or personal names are needed. Limitations: treats all preferred as non-participating and pari passu with 1:1 conversion, and does not model SAFEs or convertible notes. The result is not a 409A valuation.

cash.description: Cash on hand, in US dollars.

common_shares_outstanding.description: Number of common shares issued and outstanding (excluding options and preferred).

has_participating_preferred.description: True if any preferred series is participating.

has_unconverted_safes_or_notes.description: True if the company has SAFEs or convertible notes that have not yet converted.

options_outstanding.description: Number of share options granted and outstanding.

options_weighted_average_strike.description: Weighted average exercise price of outstanding options, in US dollars.

performance_since_last_round.description: How the company has performed against plan since its last priced round. Used when that round is more than 12 months old.

preferred_series.description: Each priced preferred share round. Leave empty or omit if the company has never raised a priced round.

name.description: Series name, for example 'Seed' or 'Series A'.

original_issue_price.description: Price paid per share, in US dollars.

revenue_growth_pct.description: Year-over-year revenue growth, as a percentage (for example 40 for 40%).

revenue_last_12_months.description: Revenue for the last 12 months, in US dollars.

risk_free_rate_pct.description: Optional current government bond yield matching years_to_exit, as a percentage.

sector.description: Company sector. Sets the default volatility and revenue multiple. Use 'other' if unsure.

total_capital_invested.description: Total equity capital invested to date, in US dollars. Used when there is no priced round and no revenue.

volatility_pct.description: Optional override for equity volatility, as a percentage.

years_to_exit.description: Expected years until a sale or IPO. Defaults to 3.

name: estimate_409a_value
title: Estimate 409A common stock value
